title.zh: Uber参与汇丰、富兰克林邓普顿等机构的区块链投资试点
title.en: Uber参与汇丰、富兰克林邓普顿等机构的区块链投资试点

current_state.zh: Uber took part in an HSBC-led pilot that used tokenized deposits to buy and redeem Franklin Templeton's tokenized money market fund over a weekend via Canton Network, earning roughly 1.5 extra days of yield versus traditional Friday exits, and HSBC says the setup is ready to roll out to other US clients.
